fee_notes: Scheduling Center Fee is additional 7% of Gross Revenues plus $40/month per Co-Op Line plus $10/month per EMS To You Business for Toll-Free Number. Advertising and Technology Fee covers both advertising and technology. Minimums may be increased with 60 days notice, capped at CPI plus 5% (royalty) or CPI plus 20% (advertising/tech) per year.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee: 5% of your Gross Revenues or a minimum of $295, per month per Protected Territory. Advertising and Technology Fee: 3% of your Gross Revenues or a minimum of $150, per month per Protected Territory.
